other_failure_modes.description: The target variable is a financial amount ('Amount in USD'), which is typically highly skewed. Training directly on the raw scale to optimize RMSE makes the model overly sensitive to outliers; a log transformation is usually required.

summary: The agent implements a basic modelling pipeline with LightGBM and CatBoost, combined using a naive equal-weight ensemble. It fails to account for the temporal nature of the data (using randomized K-Fold instead of time-based splitting) and lacks any feature engineering or target transformations for the financial amount. Furthermore, the agent does not calculate or report any validation metrics during training.
